criteria.description: The coverage decision occurs before creative artifact generation. The response does not produce a volume-level or whole-work plan and then weaken it with a disclaimer; any document-like result is titled and scoped only as a local selected-page observation.

The Agent correctly identifies that one cover, one contents page and one interior page do not establish narrative coverage. It names story-bearing early, middle and late regions whose findings must each change a distinct creative decision, plus continuous cause-action-consequence evidence for any proposed spine event.

The response does not invent a protagonist objective, connected plot, duration, format, episode structure, climax or source-wide theme from the sparse evidence. A late evidence-boundary paragraph cannot rescue an otherwise unsupported treatment.

The response gives one concise, bounded next source-review operation that would unlock a volume-level decision. It names the decision each early, middle, late or continuous-sequence batch must settle and does not turn the request into exhaustive reading, a page-by-page audit or a generic production checklist.
The result is concise, separates current evidence from future work, and contains no Tool log, internal ledger, generic analysis, generation prompt, model parameters or post-production instructions.
